ModMetaData.name: Sloppy Trashbrick Burning
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
Burn the trashbricks from Vanilla Recycling Expanded for power.
Adds two Stirling-engine generators that burn trashbricks: a cobbled pellet stove (1000W, 20 bricks a day, a little pollution) and a trashbrick gasifier (1200W on 12 a day, clean). Feed them by hand or from a hopper on their intake. Switch them to turbine feed and pipe their heat to a steam turbine for about 40% more power.
With Dubs Bad Hygiene: fecal sludge pellets as a second fuel, and a plumbing connection - water-cool the engine for more power, or run it as a boiler for hot water and central heating at reduced power. With Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory: belt-fed through factory hoppers.
Needs Vanilla Recycling Expanded, and is researched after complex recycling.
